 KOTTAYAM, PIN- 686013  6 . UNION GOVERNMENT  MINISTER OF RAILWAYS, REPRESENTED BY THE  DIVISIONAL RAILWAY MANAGER, (THIRUVANANTHAPURAM DIVISION),

 KOZHIKODE, PIN- 673006  9. GURUVAYUR DEVASWOM MANAGING COMMITTEE,

 ORUMKAL KADAV ROAD, ERUMELI, KOTTAYAM-686 509  11. ERUMELI GRAMA PANCHAYATH  REPRESENTED BY ITS SECRETARY, SH 44, ERUMELI, KOTTAYAM-686 509  *ARE SUO MOTU IMPLEADED AS ADDITIONAL RESPONDENTS 10 AND 11 VIDE  ORDER DATED 14/12/2023 IN IN SSCR NO.36 OF 2023 Suo Motu vs State Of Kerala on 12 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/150521003/
2  BY SRI.S.MANU, DEPUTY SOLICITOR GENERAL OF INDIA  BY SRI.S.RAJMOHAN, SR.GOVERNMENT PLEADER  BY SRI.G.BIJU, STANDING COUNSEL FOR TRAVANCORE DEVASWOM BOARD  BY STANDING COUNSEL FOR COCHIN DEVASWOM BOARD  BY STANDING COUNSEL FOR GURUVAYUR DEVASWOM MANAGING COMMITTEE  BY STANDING COUNSEL FOR MALABAR DEVASWOM BOARD  BY SRI.N.RAGHURAJ, AMICUS CURIAE, SABARIMALA SPL.COMMISSIONER  BY SRI.JIBU P.THOMAS, SC, ERUMELI GRAMA PANCHAYATH (R11)
 THIS SABARIMALA SPECIAL COMMISSIONER REPORT ALONG WITH CONNECTED CASES HAVING COME UP FOR ORDERS AGAIN ON 12/01/2024, UPON PERUSING THE REPORT AND THIS COURT'S COMMON ORDERS DATED 11/01/2024, THE COURT ON THE SAME DAY PASSED THE FOLLOWING. 
 ANIL K. NARENDRAN & G. GIRISH, JJ. 
 -----------------------------------------------------
 SSCR Nos.29, 30 and 36 of 2023 & 3 and 4 of 2024  --------------------------------------------------------
 Dated this the 12th day of January, 2024  ORDER Anil K. Narendran, J.
The District Medical Officer (Health), Kuyilimala, Painavu, Idukki- 685603 is suo motu impleaded as additional respondent No.34 in SSCR No.29 of 2023.
2. On 11.01.2024, when these matters came up for consideration at 10.15 a.m., this Court passed a detailed order on crowd management and other aspects in connection with Makaravilakku festival season of 1199 ME (2024) in Sabarimala. 
3. By the order dated 09.01.2024 in SSCR No.5 of 2024, this Court directed the 2nd respondent Travancore Devaswom Board to provide Annadana Distribution Counter at Pandithavalam, in the area identified by the Special Commissioner, Sabarimala, in Annexure 1 sketch, where cooked food and drinking water from the Annadanam Hall at Malikappuram shall be distributed to the pilgrims on 14.01.2024 and 15.01.2024. The Board was directed to ensure toilet facilities at Pandithavalam and the Police and the District Administration were directed to take necessary steps to ensure the safety of the pilgrims at Pandithavalam and other Makarajyothi view points by providing barricades Suo Motu vs State Of Kerala on 12 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/150521003/
3 and other facilities. 
4. The District Collector, Pathanamthitta and the District Police SSCR Nos.29, 30 and 36 of 2023 and 3 and 4 of 2024 Chief, Pathanamthitta conducted a joint inspection at Makarajyothi view points in Pathanamthitta District and the District Collector, Idukki and the District Police Chief, Idukki conducted a joint inspection at Makarajyothi view points in Idukki District in order to ensure the safety of the pilgrims at those locations and to provide proper facilities to pilgrims on 14.01.2024 and 15.01.2024. Police Bandobust arrangements at Makarajyothi view points in Pathanamthitta and Idukki Districts prepared by the District Police Chief, Pathanamthitta and the District Police Chief,
Idukki were also made available for the perusal of this Court. 
5. Having considered the aforesaid materials and also the submissions made at the Bar, we deem it appropriate to direct the Chief Police Co-ordinator at Sannidhanam and also the District Administration and District Police Chief at Pathanamthitta and Idukki to ensure proper crowd management at Sabarimala, Pamba and Nilakkal and also at Makarajyothi view points, with specific reference to the holding capacity of each locations/view points, taking note of the recommendations of Justice M.R.Hariharan Nair Commission and also the directions contained in the orders in SSCR No.23 of 2022.
6. On a query made by this Court, the learned Senior Government Pleader would submit that the medical team under the control of the 12th respondent District Medical Officer (Health),
Pathanamthitta and also that under the additional 34th respondent SSCR Nos.29, 30 and 36 of 2023 and 3 and 4 of 2024 District Medical Officer (Health), Idukki have already made necessary arrangements to extend medical support to the pilgrims during Makarajyothi darshan. Ambulance facility is provided in all Makarajyothi view points except Ayyanmala, where it is provided at a distance of 1 k.m. away from the view point.
7. Having considered the materials on record and also the submissions made at the Bar, we deem it appropriate to direct the 12 th respondent District Medical Officer (Health), Pathanamthitta and also the additional 34th respondent District Medical Officer (Health), Idukki to extend necessary medical facilities to pilgrims during the Makarajyothi darshan, taking note of the directions contained in the order of this Court dated 20.01.2023 in SSCR No.23 of 2022 and that contained in SSCR No.29 of 2023.
8. The learned Standing Counsel for KSRTC would submit that around 400 KSRTC buses are being deployed for Nilakkal-Pamba chain service during Makarajyothi darshan. 
9. Regarding the operation of Nilakkal-Pamba chain service by KSRTC, this Court has issued various directions in the order dated 20.01.2023 in SSCR No.23 of 2022, which was followed by specific directions issued in SSCR No.29 of 2023. The Chief Police Co-ordinator at Sannidhanam shall ensure, through the Special Officers at Nilakkal and Pamba, that the movement of pilgrims in Nilakkal-Pamba KSRTC chain service is regulated during Makarajyothi darshan, strictly in terms SSCR Nos.29, 30 and 36 of 2023 and 3 and 4 of 2024 of the directions contained in the aforesaid orders of this Court. 
Suo Motu vs State Of Kerala on 12 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/150521003/
4 10. The learned Standing Counsel for Travancore Devaswom Board would submit that based on a decision taken by the Board, there is no spot booking facility from 10.01.2024 onwards till 15.01.2024. Virtual-Q slots on 14.01.2024 and 15.01.2024 are limited to 50,000 and 40,000 respectively. The learned Standing Counsel would submit that certain restrictions will have to be imposed on the movement of pilgrims from Nilakkal and thereafter from Pamba on 15.01.2024 due to 'Thiruvabharanam' procession. 
11. In the report filed by the Special Commissioner, Sabarimala, which is incorporated in SSCR No.29 of 2023, it is suggested that the entry of pilgrims from Nilakkal on 15.01.2024 may be restricted after 9.30 a.m. and that from Pamba after 10.30 a.m., in order to ensure that most of the pilgrims can ascend 'Pathinettampadi' by the time the temple closes at 1.00 p.m. and that, the path of the 'Thiruvabharanam' procession enroute Sannidhanam and at Nadapanthal can be made sterile.
12. The learned Senior Government Pleader, on instructions from the Chief Police Co-ordinator at Sannidhanam, would submit that the restriction at Nilakkal may be at 9.00 a.m. and that at Pamba may be at 10.30 a.m., in order to ensure that all the pilgrims who reach Pamba can proceed to Sannidhanam before 10.30 a.m.
13. Having considered the submissions made at the Bar, we SSCR Nos.29, 30 and 36 of 2023 and 3 and 4 of 2024 deem it appropriate to direct the Chief Police Co-ordinator at Sannidhanam to ensure through the Special Officers at Nilakkal and Pamba that, on 15.01.2024 the entry of pilgrims from Nilakkal is blocked after 9.00 a.m. and the entry from Pamba to Sannidhanam is blocked at 10.30 a.m. After Uchapooja, the sanctum sanctorum will be closed by 1.00 p.m. Thereafter, pilgrims will be permitted darshan only after Makarajyothi and Makarasamkrama pooja. After Makarasamkramapooja, the pilgrims at Sannidhanam have to move towards Pamba through Neelimala and also Swami Ayyappan Road. Therefore, the movement of pilgrims from Nilakkal to Pamba and from Pamba to Sannidhanam shall remain suspended till 8.30 p.m. on 15.01.2024. The Board and also the police shall give wide publicity to the restrictions imposed in connection with 'Thiruvabharanam' procession on 15.01.2024, to the pilgrims through print and visual media and also through Virtual-Q platform. 
14. In the orders passed by this Court in SSCR No.29 of 2023, directions have been issued to ensure that the pilgrims stranded in the queue for considerably long period are provided with medicated drinking water and biscuits. The directions contained in the aforesaid orders shall be complied with in letter and spirit by all concerned, during Makarajyothi darshan, in order to ensure that the pilgrims have a safe and comfortable darshan. 
15. List on 15.01.2024.
SSCR Nos.29, 30 and 36 of 2023 and 3 and 4 of 2024 In case any further directions are necessary, it would be open to the learned Senior Government Pleader, the learned Standing Counsel for Travancore Devaswom Board or the learned Amicus Curiae to bring up the matter before the Bench. 
On such request, Registry shall list the matter forthwith, after obtaining the orders of the Hon'ble the Chief Justice.
